{{Quote|Unknown any Rebel privateer vessel ''Martinette.'' Suspect ruse &mdash; pirates or Imperial spies.|Captain [[Ixsthmus]]|<ref name="GodkingRe">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>}}
The '''''Martinette''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], with customized modifications. It was used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jayhawk]] and his crew.

==History==
Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jayhawk]] used the ''Martinette'' in attacks to other [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. He pretended to be a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. With this charade, Jayhawk boarded several ships, stealing the cargo and sometimes the ship itself, leaving the crew stranded. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the ''Martinette'' attempted to attack the modified yacht ''[[Long Shot]]''&mdash;which was really a ship of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The ''Long Shot'' dealt with the pirates.<ref name="Godking" />

==Layout and modifications==
The ''Martinette'' had several customizations, including improved, heavier shields and better engines for increased speed.<ref name="Godking" />
